options.content:
**Model totals** follow namespace and model; instance, role and rank narrow backend details only. **Frontend and routing** follow the frontend selector; shared frontend traffic includes every model.

Rates use a rolling window. **No data** means no observations, not zero. Scrape counts show reporting endpoints, not service readiness.

targets.expr: (sum by(namespace,model_group,engine) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(rate(vllm:prompt_tokens_total{endpoint="model-server",namespace=~"$namespace",model_name=~"$model_name",inference_foretoken_io_model_group!="",inference_foretoken_io_model_role!="",inference_foretoken_io_model_group=~"$model_group",inference_foretoken_io_model_role=~"$model_role",engine=~"$engine",inference_foretoken_io_model_role=~"aggregate|prefill"}[$__rate_interval]), "model_group", "$1", "inference_foretoken_io_model_group", "(.+)"), "model_role", "$1", "inference_foretoken_io_model_role", "(.+)"), "pd_pipeline_scope", "$1", "inference_foretoken_io_pd_pipeline_scope", "(.+)"))) * on(namespace,model_group) group_left(model_group_display) (max by(namespace,model_group,model_group_display) ((label_join((label_join(max_over_time(foretoken:model_instance_info{namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__range] @ end()), "model_group_display", " / ", "modelservice", "model_pool", "model_instance")) and on(model_group_display) (count by(model_group_display) (label_join(max_over_time(foretoken:model_instance_info{namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__range] @ end()), "model_group_display", " / ", "modelservice", "model_pool", "model_instance")) > 1), "model_group_display", " / ", "model_group_display", "namespace", "model_instance_created_at")) or ((label_join(max_over_time(foretoken:model_instance_info{namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__range] @ end()), "model_group_display", " / ", "modelservice", "model_pool", "model_instance")) unless on(model_group_display) (count by(model_group_display) (label_join(max_over_time(foretoken:model_instance_info{namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__range] @ end()), "model_group_display", " / ", "modelservice", "model_pool", "model_instance")) > 1))))

panels.description: Whole-model latency from Frontend processing to generation completion, in seconds; aggregate and decode requests are combined.

panels.description: Whole-model time from Frontend processing to the first output token, in seconds; aggregate and decode requests are combined.

panels.description: Accepted draft tokens divided by proposed draft tokens across all engines. No drafts produce no ratio; this is not a speedup estimate.
